caution: No profit guarantee. Old folds are reused research. Only one rule checked on two new sessions; L2 contribution not tested.

portfolio.drawdown: realised equity plus cost of remaining positions; intrabar risk not measured
portfolio.same_time_priority: expected net descending, then ticker; no outcome ranking
portfolio.unknown: reserve capital/risk for full hour, report unknown, withhold profit/readiness

rules.compression: previous 7-bar range <55% previous 20 range; close > prior7 high, seasonal volume>=1.2, above rising EMA50
rules.costs: 0 / 5bps fee+5bps slip each side / double costs; zero costs diagnostic only
rules.efficient_trend: 20-bar efficiency>=0.55, three increasing closes, close>prior8 high, above rising EMA50
rules.entry: next contiguous bar open; weekday decision closes 10:30..14:30 MSK
rules.exhaustion: prior red body>=1 ATR14 and seasonal volume>=2; current green close>prior midpoint in top half
rules.false_low: current low below prior20 low, close reclaims it in top quarter, green candle
rules.fresh_check: lock one audit candidate before reading Oct19..20; if none passes screen, audit highest ranked sufficiently sampled failure, NOT an approved strategy; never select on fresh results
rules.gap_repair: 10:00 open below prior weekday regular close by>=0.3%; new upward crossing of gap midpoint before12:00
rules.laggard_recovery: own 1h return<peer median-0.3pp, peer median>0, close>previous high, green candle
rules.limitations: old dates repeatedly studied; survivor universe; candle-only; assumed costs, no historical L2, dividends, taxes or real fill validation; two new sessions not proof
rules.peers: median return over 4 bars, exact current timestamp, >=4 OTHER stocks, no forward filling
rules.quiet_pullback: above rising EMA50, preceding 4-bar return<0, previous seasonal volume<=1, close>previous high
rules.relative_leader: own 1h return>peer median+0.15pp, peer median>0, >=60% peers positive, green candle, above EMA50
rules.seasonal_volume: same opening HH:MM, previous 20 weekdays, at least 5 observations; excludes today
rules.selection: screen needs >=40 trades total, >=3 each old fold, no unknowns, positive BASE and DOUBLE in ALL four folds; rank by worst double-cost fold then sum, alphabetical tie
rules.stop: 3 ATR14 known at signal close, minimum 0.5% entry; gap open or stop-first low
rules.tie_break: alphabetical ticker; no future-return ranking; no multiple entries per ticker before full horizon

spec.source_scope: economic hypotheses only, not reproduction of published horizons/markets/returns
